dedupe_keys.name: european investment bank open data financed projects project pipeline infrastructure equity funds elena and jaspers projects

description: The European Investment Bank (EIB) states that the data it collects on the projects it finances, the equity funds it supports and its investment and climate surveys are openly available to the public, and lists them on its open data page. For infrastructure, the relevant sets are the financed projects list, searchable by region, country and sector from 1959 to 2026 with signature date and amount; the pipeline of projects to be financed; the global investment map; the list of infrastructure equity funds and environmental funds with vintage year, sector and geography; ELENA (European Local ENergy Assistance) projects in energy efficiency and sustainable transport, ongoing and completed, with a map; and JASPERS assignments, which help cities and regions use EU funds, searchable by period, country, sector and status. Coverage: EU member states and EIB Global regions, including enlargement countries, the Eastern and Southern Neighbourhoods, Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, Asia and the Pacific, and Central Asia. Format and access: web lists and maps; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): EIB terms of use: no publication or commercial exploitation without prior written permission unless otherwise permitted. Caveats: the lists are rendered by scripts and no bulk export or API was found on the pages read, so fields beyond those named were not checked. Simulation uses: locations, sectors and amounts of financed infrastructure projects for investment pipelines and planning scenarios. Related records: the World Bank PPI database (data-world-bank-ppi-database) covers private participation in infrastructure, and AidData (data-aiddata-china-official-seaport-finance) covers Chinese port finance.
